# Professional Electric Nail Drill: Rechargeable 35,000 RPM E-File Kit

Get polished, salon-style results at home or on the go. This rechargeable electric nail drill kit handles gel and acrylic nails, manicures, and pedicures, with everything you need for shaping, smoothing, and nail art in one set.

## Adjustable Power for Every Task

A rotating knob lets you set speeds from 0 to 35,000 RPM. Switch between forward and reverse rotation, and the LED screen shows your speed, direction, and power level. Choose a gentle speed for delicate detail work or a higher setting for filing, and the kit works for both right- and left-handed users.

## Comfortable, Quiet Operation

The lightweight aluminum alloy handpiece fits comfortably in your hand, and its ventilation design helps keep the drill cool. Low heat, low noise, and low vibration make each session easier to control and more relaxing.

## Sixteen Bits for Complete Nail Care

Sixteen bits with a universal 3/32-inch shank cover shaping, edge refining, cuticle exfoliation, and detailed nail art. Six sanding bands, a 7-sided polishing strip, and a polishing pen holder add finishing options, so you can move from prep to polish without switching tools.

## Portable and Easy to Clean

At about the size of a pen, the drill slips into a bag for travel. The rechargeable battery runs for up to 10 hours, and the parts wipe clean quickly after each use.

Order your Professional Electric Nail Drill Kit today and start creating polished, professional-looking nails whenever you want them.
